turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have about twenty minutes. Where is the zero coming from, Hale, and who decided it went in before anyone called me?
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.
I didn't come for thanks, Hale. The zero went in on Tuesday, November 3, and Owen found out on his phone in the middle of class. What do you have?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94 percent.
A machine's guess. The company that sells it says it shouldn't be the only basis for punishing a student, so what else do you have, Hale?
That's very high. The software is quite reliable.

"Quite reliable." Researchers tested fourteen of these tools in 2023 and called them "neither accurate nor reliable". Your own procedure, section 4.3, says software results don't establish a concern by themselves, so the zero comes off.
So I had to give him a zero.
"Had to." Your procedure, 4.2, says the parent is contacted before any mark is entered, and nobody called me. Did you speak to Owen before you entered it?
I hope you understand my position.
"I hope." My position is that the zero comes off, and you still haven't told me whether you spoke to Owen before you entered it.
